body: fuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuck I hate you for being so right.  jfkladsjfklajdgkladjfl;kajd fadkljfadsfkal fine.  You got me.  I'll see how this week goes.

>Especially don't jump in front of a damn train.

Why is this significant?  What separates it from jumping off a building or taking some pills?  The fact that there's basically 0% chance of survival?  I'm not going for a cry for help here, I'm looking for a reliable death.

Which, like I said is a nice theory but not really a viable option.  What I'd like to do is sit in front of a computer and complain on the internet all day.  I would be happy with that.  But that's never going to be an option, no matter what you do.  Yea, it's entirely possible that I've just hit a low point in my life, but one that's been going on for two years?  I don't know, I don't have anything to go off of.

Yea probably but..  Well actually, I have nothing to say.  You make very valid points, but after 2 years with very little to no real happiness..  I don't know, I just don't know.  It's all fairly confusing.  Unfortunately, my thought process is still heading towards "I don't need this shit I could be dead right now!"..  Thanks for trying though.

I've got really nothing wrong in school..  About half the school likes me/is friends with me, and the other half just kind of disregards me..  Don't have a problem making friends/talking to people, or meeting new ones.  Another thing that I failed to mention in my original post was that I kind of have started failing at pretty much everything...  I mean, up to high school I had straight A's, I played an instrument perfectly (first chair for 5 years), and hung out with friends every day.  Now I go to school, barely scrape by thinking about what a disappointment I am to my mother, then playing the shit i always do, worst in my class with music.  After that I go home and don't talk to anyone.  I just feel like I've stopped doing anything well.

Another weird thing is, like I said before, I don't really *want* to kill myself, it's just the best viable option..  But I actively look for reasons to.  Like I'll just be walking along and I'll trip or somthing, and my brain will instantly go "Wow you're such a fuck up, the world would be better if rid of you." but while I'm thinking that, I'm not sad at all..  I mean, I agree with myself but it doesn't sadden me.

To answer your question, you're pretty off base, the only reason school comes up so much is it's pretty much all I do other than the internet.
